column1: # Crates surveyed besides the top N, or again with other features: name, features (comma-separated; `-default` turns
# the default features off; empty: the defaults), category, why. `survey.py list` adds them to crates.tsv with their
# latest stable version, after the top N. Every row must build with rustc on x86_64 Linux.

column4: the async runtime as applications use it (the top-N row has tokio's default features: none)
serde as most crates depend on it (its derive macros re-exported)
clap as most programs depend on it
the embedded async executor, on its std platform
embassy's timers, with the std time driver
critical sections, with the std implementation
the embedded logging framework (a library; its linker script is for firmware)
